title: GNN Graph Schema v1
description: v2 extends v1 with Track A formation structure (11_vs_11 only) and Track B continuous shape descriptors (academy scenarios). Machine-readable schema for GMN-Football-3 GNN graph representations.

global_id.description: Deterministic ID: {team}_{0-based index within team}. Matches 127-dim observation ordering (left indices 0-10, right indices 0-10).

team_index.description: 0-based index within the player's team array. Corresponds to the player's slot in the 127-dim observation (left: indices 0-21, right: indices 44-65).

x.description: Pitch x in [-1.0, 1.0]. Source: ObservationEncoder.ts indices 0-21 (left) or 44-65 (right).

y.description: Pitch y in [-0.42, 0.42]. Source: ObservationEncoder.ts indices 0-21 (left) or 44-65 (right).

vx.description: Velocity x scaled by 50. Source: ObservationEncoder.ts indices 22-43 (left) or 66-87 (right).

vy.description: Velocity y scaled by 50. Source: ObservationEncoder.ts indices 22-43 (left) or 66-87 (right).

role.description: Tactical role. Source: ScenarioConfig.setup.leftPlayers/rightPlayers role field, or inferPlayerRole() fallback (Contract.ts:74-112).

role_one_hot.description: 12-float one-hot over ROLE_VOCABULARY. Source: ObservationEncoder.ts indices 115-126.

is_active.description: True if this player is the active/controlled viewpoint. Source: ObservationEncoder.ts indices 97-107 active player one-hot.

is_controlled.description: True if this player is the RL-controlled player (controlledPlayerId). Source: GameEngine.ts controlledPlayerId.

is_goalkeeper.description: True if role is GK. Source: Player.isGoalkeeper (GameEngine.ts:170).

nearest_teammate_dist.description: Euclidean distance to the nearest present teammate (excluding self). Derivable from left/right team position arrays (ObservationEncoder.ts indices 0-21 / 44-65).

nearest_opponent_dist.description: Euclidean distance to the nearest present opponent. Derivable from cross-team position arrays.

team_width.description: max(y) - min(y) among present teammates. Derivable from left/right team y-coordinates (indices 1,3,5... or 45,47,49...).

team_depth.description: max(x) - min(x) among present teammates. Derivable from left/right team x-coordinates (indices 0,2,4... or 44,46,48...).

compactness.description: Mean pairwise Euclidean distance among all present teammates. Derivable from team position arrays.

stretch.description: Alias for team_depth (max x - min x among present teammates). Derivable from team position arrays.

receiver_availability.description: 1.0 if nearest_opponent_dist > NEAR threshold (0.065), else 0.0. Binary openness signal derived from nearest-opponent distance.

line_id.description: Deterministic line assignment from 1D gap-detection on teammate x-coordinates. 0 = deepest (most defensive) line. Computed by sorting teammates by x, splitting at gaps > 0.15. Track B only: no formation template used. For 11_vs_11, this is derived from actual positions, not from the FORMATIONS template.

lane_id.description: Deterministic lane assignment from 1D gap-detection on teammate y-coordinates. 0 = lowest y (top of pitch from left teams view). Computed by sorting teammates by y, splitting at gaps > 0.15. Track B only: no formation template used.

vx.description: Velocity x scaled by 50. Source: ObservationEncoder.ts index 91.

vy.description: Velocity y scaled by 50. Source: ObservationEncoder.ts index 92.

vz.description: Velocity z scaled by 50. Source: ObservationEncoder.ts index 93.

ownership.description: Ball ownership. Source: ObservationEncoder.ts indices 94-96 one-hot.

speed.description: Euclidean norm of velocity vector. Derivable from ball velocity components.

node_id.description: Deterministic goal ID: goal_left at x=-1.0, goal_right at x=1.0.

team.description: Which team's goal line this is. goal_left is the goal defended by the left team (at x=-1.0). goal_right is the goal defended by the right team (at x=1.0).

x.description: Goal line x coordinate. Source: Rules.ts PITCH.minX (-1.0) for goal_left, PITCH.maxX (1.0) for goal_right.

y.description: Goal center y coordinate. Source: Rules.ts goal geometry is centered at y=0.

width.description: Goal mouth width. Source: Rules.ts PITCH.goalWidth = 0.14 (y from -0.07 to 0.07).

height.description: Goal crossbar height. Source: Rules.ts PITCH.goalHeight = 0.05.

depth.description: Goal depth behind goal line. Source: Rules.ts PITCH.goalDepth = 0.04.

time_limit_seconds.description: Episode time limit in seconds. Source: ScenarioConfig.timeLimitSeconds (ScenarioRegistry.ts).

terminate_on_opponent_possession.description: If true, episode terminates when right team gains possession. Source: ScenarioConfig.terminateOnOpponentPossession (ScenarioRegistry.ts).

objectives.description: Scenario objectives. Source: ScenarioConfig.objectives (ScenarioRegistry.ts). Evaluated by GameEngine.ts:1192-1269.

scoring.description: Reward for scoring a goal. Source: ScenarioConfig.rewards.scoring.

completion.description: Reward for completing all objectives. Source: ScenarioConfig.rewards.completion.

id.description: Objective identifier. Known values: score_goal, within_time, complete_pass, create_triangle, retain_possession, complete_passes, win_match, control_possession, clean_sheet. Source: ScenarioRegistry.ts objectives arrays.

is_completed.description: True if objective was achieved. Set by GameEngine.ts evaluateScenarioConditions().

is_failed.description: True if objective was failed. Set by GameEngine.ts evaluateScenarioConditions().

distance.description: Euclidean distance between the two players at graph construction time.

threshold.description: Distance threshold for NEAR edge inclusion. Justification: Physics.ts:348 uses distToBall < 0.065 as the proximity check for tackle execution. A player within 0.065 units of an opponent is close enough to dispossess, making this a defensible 'near/pressure' threshold.

source.description: Player global_id who possesses the ball.

target.description: Fixed target node ID for the ball.

inter_line_spacing_variance.description: Variance of inter-line spacing. Computed from consecutive line centroid x-gaps. 0 when fewer than 2 lines exist. See Phase 2 section 3.3.1.

mean_line_compactness.description: Mean per-line compactness (population std of y within line, normalized by team width). See Phase 2 section 3.3.2.

num_lines.description: Number of distinct lines detected for this team via gap-detection on x.

num_lanes.description: Number of distinct lanes detected for this team via gap-detection on y.

slot_id.description: Deterministic ID: {team}_{0-based index in FORMATIONS array}. Source: Rules.ts FORMATIONS array index.

role.description: Tactical role from FormationNode.role. Source: Rules.ts FormationNode.

xRatio.description: Template x-ratio from FormationNode.xRatio. Source: Rules.ts FormationNode.

yRatio.description: Template y-ratio from FormationNode.yRatio. Source: Rules.ts FormationNode.

x.description: Absolute pitch x computed by getFormationPositions. Source: Rules.ts:141-168.

y.description: Absolute pitch y computed by getFormationPositions. Source: Rules.ts:141-168.

line_id.description: Line identifier: 0=GK, 1=Defense, 2=Midfield, 3=Attack. Derived from xRatio bands (Phase 2 section 2.4).

lane_id.description: Lane identifier: 0=Left, 1=Center, 2=Right. Derived from yRatio bands (Phase 2 section 2.5).
